OUR STORY

Yellowstone, closer to everyone.

When we visited Yellowstone, we were struck by its extraordinary beauty—and by how difficult it can be for some people to experience it in person.

How it began

Yellowstone is vast. Reaching a well-known viewpoint can mean a long journey, and some experiences involve walking, uneven ground, or steps. I thought about older visitors and people with limited mobility who might want to see these places but find the trip challenging.

That experience inspired me to film Yellowstone’s remarkable sights in 4K and create a way to share the park with people wherever they live.

Explore at your own pace

Yellowstone From Home brings together a real map, scenic videos, and an interactive AI guide. Choose a place, watch its landscape unfold, and ask questions by typing or speaking. You can pause, return, and explore for as long as you like.

We hope this makes Yellowstone easier to discover for older adults, people with limited mobility, families far from the park, and anyone who simply wants to learn from home.

Our collection is growing. While we prepare our own 4K footage for the site, some featured films are provided by credited creators. AI guide answers are for exploration and may be inaccurate.
